authorship: Original project-authored trait tables. No copied dialogue, real people, or GTA story characters.
note: Each ambient pedestrian draws one combination, seeded by its actor id, with a name no stored actor already uses. Model names supply only presentation, age band, clothing or uniform, and whether the person is local or visiting. Ethnicity- or body-coded model names deliberately supply no traits.
